summary.intent: Plan, verify, execute, and ship phase 63 (Read-Chain Navigation and Rotation Core) — a crypto navigation walk, grant/invite re-wrap primitives, and rotation engine for sdk-core — using the full GSD autonomous pipeline.
summary.outcome: Planning completed and verified (7 plans / 4 waves, plan-checker passed on iteration 2 after fixing 1 blocker + 2 warnings). Execution reached mid-Wave 1 with 63-01 and 63-02 complete and 63-03 dispatched; execution and /ship-phase were not finished before the transcript ended.

repo: Phase 63 targets sdk-core (backend crypto only, frontend: false) — navigation walk, grant issuance, invite re-wrap, and rotation engine with 4 named Phase-64 seams deferred intentionally.

Sequential plan execution in the main worktree is preferred over parallel worktrees due to shared folder.test.ts between 63-01/63-04 and documented worktree pitfalls (node_modules leaks, api:generate side effects).
The CI health-poll pattern for the local API is: port 3000, endpoint /health, bounded curl loop — mirrors what's already in CI scripts.
The codebase map at .planning/codebase/ can be stale; drift gate flags it but it is non-blocking at plan time when CONTEXT.md and RESEARCH.md carry verified current implementation-site references.
Commit signing was already disabled repo-locally (commit.gpgsign: false) before the session — no biometric prompts expected.
Pattern mapper found 10/10 analogs, confirming strong established patterns for all 7 plans before the planner ran.

code.finding: Had a fragile `sleep 12` for API startup; replaced with a bounded health-poll loop mirroring the CI pattern (curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health).
Open Questions section required explicit `(RESOLVED)` markers to pass the plan-checker blocker; questions were substantively answered in the body but the heading lacked the marker.
Must be filled with per-task verification map and nyquist_compliant: true during planning (not left as template skeleton) — plan-checker flags unfilled VALIDATION.md as a warning.

workflow: GSD commit helper consistently reports false-negatives (helper says failure, but commit lands); always verify with git log or git status rather than trusting the helper's exit signal.
Plan-checker iteration loop: fix blockers deterministically in the orchestrator (no need to re-spawn the planner), then re-spawn only the checker — iteration 2 cleared all findings.
AGENT_SKILLS_RESEARCHER resolves empty because the researcher subagent carries its own full system prompt; the orchestrator does not need to inject additional skills.
Nyquist VALIDATION.md must be written from template immediately after research commits (step 5.5) and fully populated before committing fixes, not deferred to execution.

friction: GSD commit helper false-negatives on every single commit throughout the session — required manual git log verification each time, adding noise to every step.
Plan-checker iteration 1 returned a blocker (RESEARCH.md open questions missing RESOLVED markers) that required reading and editing multiple large files before re-verification could run.
Stale codebase map flagged by drift gate — non-blocking but adds visual noise and requires explicit acknowledgment on every plan run.
VALIDATION.md left as unfilled template skeleton after step 5.5 triggered a plan-checker warning; filling it required extracting task IDs and automated commands from all 7 plan files manually.
